integration.project_method_name: AdaBN / Test-Time Norm (single-image episodic batch statistics)
differences_from_upstream_norm: The upstream CIFAR-10-C example uses batches of 200 and resets once per corruption-severity condition; this project processes one segmentation image per episode and restores source state after every image.

Upstream Norm defaults to track_running_stats=true, so training-mode forwards update BatchNorm running buffers even though current-batch statistics determine each output; this project disables running-stat tracking during the temporary AdaBN forward and requires all running buffers to remain unchanged.
Upstream configure_model forces BatchNorm eps=1e-5 and momentum=0.1; this project preserves the source checkpoint's BatchNorm eps and momentum values.

Upstream reset restores only the post-configuration state_dict; this project restores the complete pre-episode source state, including parameters, buffers, module training flags, BatchNorm runtime attributes, requires_grad flags, gradients, and registered extra state.
This project explicitly keeps every non-BatchNorm module in evaluation mode, freezes all parameters, and performs no backward pass or optimizer step for AdaBN.

The upstream example is a CIFAR-10 classifier; this project adapts NS-FPN raw binary-segmentation logits through the project model adapter and never exposes labels or ground-truth masks to the episodic method.
